app.name: Open Deutsch
app.tagline: A focused place to build confident German.

practice.title: Practice
practice.intro: Pick one exercise type, then work in a focused space. Your generated exercises stay here when you are ready to continue.

chooser.title: Choose a practice type
chooser.body: Choose a format to see its setup and start when you are ready.

custom.title: Create a quiz
custom.body: Describe what you want to practise. The quiz can mix multiple choice, gap fills, sentence correction, and short written answers.

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.body: Read a short explanation, then answer gap-fill, sentence-correction, and short-answer questions.

reading.title: Reading
reading.body: Read a short everyday text, choose comprehension answers, and write a brief summary.

listening.title: Listening
listening.body: Prepare listening questions for Codex Voice. Audio is not played inside Open Deutsch.

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.body: Prepare a practical role-play with prompts and correction goals, then speak in Codex Voice.

diagnostic.title: Practice diagnostic
diagnostic.body: Try three grammar, vocabulary and reading samples without changing your selected level.

library.title: Saved activities
library.body: Open saved instructions or a generated exercise set. Listening and speaking activities are in their own sections below.
library.empty: No activities are waiting. Choose a practice type below to get started.
library.deleteBody: This permanently removes the activity and its unconfirmed vocabulary candidates.
library.deleteCascadeBody: This permanently removes the quiz, its attempts, answers, feedback, related History entries, and unconfirmed vocabulary candidates.

deleteBlocked.retained-data: {{title}} has completed results, retained feedback or confirmed vocabulary and cannot be deleted here.

session.lessonHint: Open the explanation when you need it

grammarLesson.title: Focused grammar lesson
grammarLesson.body: Generate a lesson at your selected learning level using the curriculum and available saved mistake evidence.
grammarLesson.topic: Starter topic: dative articles after common prepositions.
grammarLesson.request: Create a grammar lesson at my current learning level on dative articles after mit and zu, with a clear explanation, examples, hints, guided practice, and one free-production exercise.

readingFlow.title: Read and practise German
readingFlow.body: Generate a German passage for your learning level, or create questions from text you paste below. Codex prepares passage-specific exercises and reviews your written answers.
readingFlow.bundledPassage: Die Arztpraxis bittet Patientinnen und Patienten, zehn Minuten vor einem Termin zu kommen. Die Sprechstunde beginnt um 10:00 Uhr in Raum 2.
readingFlow.defaultRequest: Practise understanding a short everyday German text, including vocabulary, inference and a written summary.

listeningFlow.title: Listening in Codex Voice
listeningFlow.body: Prepare a bounded listening activity with a script, objectives, questions, and answer guidance. Open Deutsch does not create, import, store, or play audio.
listeningFlow.script: A caller asks to move an appointment from Tuesday morning to Thursday at 14:00 because of a work shift.
listeningFlow.objectiveOne: Identify the original and new appointment times.
listeningFlow.objectiveTwo: Catch the reason for the change and the requested confirmation.
listeningFlow.questionOne: What was the original appointment time?
listeningFlow.questionTwo: Why does the caller need a change?
listeningFlow.guidanceOne: Give the gist first, then cite the time and reason as evidence.
listeningFlow.guidanceTwo: Mark an item developing when the audio interaction was not completed.
listeningFlow.voiceStart: Continue with the saved activity in Codex Voice:
listeningFlow.voiceStepOne: Select Open in Codex for this activity.
listeningFlow.voiceStepTwo: Send the prepared message to load this exact activity.
listeningFlow.voiceStepThree: Select Start voice chat in the same task when available.
listeningFlow.savedBody: Open or delete a prepared activity. Codex can retrieve the exact structured context through the Open Deutsch plugin.
listeningFlow.deleteBody: This permanently removes the prepared activity.

speakingFlow.title: Speaking scenario in Codex Voice
speakingFlow.body: Prepare a practical Germany role-play with Conversation Partner behavior, a level target, and correction timing. Live speech stays in Codex Voice.
speakingFlow.onePerLine: Enter one goal or prompt per line.
speakingFlow.objectiveOne: Explain why you need to change the appointment.
speakingFlow.objectiveTwo: Suggest a new time and ask for confirmation politely.
speakingFlow.questionOne: Can you explain the change in one clear sentence?
speakingFlow.questionTwo: How will you suggest Thursday at 14:00?
speakingFlow.guidanceOne: The Conversation Partner speaks German first and adapts difficulty to A2.
speakingFlow.guidanceTwo: Correct after each answer and end with issues, vocabulary, feedback, and next steps.
speakingFlow.voiceStart: Continue with this scenario in Codex Voice:
speakingFlow.voiceStepOne: Select Open in Codex for this activity.
speakingFlow.voiceStepTwo: Send the prepared message to load this exact activity.
speakingFlow.voiceStepThree: Select Start voice chat in the same task when available.
speakingFlow.savedBody: Open or delete a prepared scenario. Codex can retrieve its exact goals and prompts through the Open Deutsch plugin.
speakingFlow.deleteBody: This permanently removes the prepared scenario.

diagnosticFlow.title: Optional practice diagnostic
diagnosticFlow.body: Three short samples: grammar, vocabulary, and reading. Your learning level stays unchanged.
diagnosticFlow.skipped: Skipped for now. You can return to this diagnostic from Practice.
diagnosticFlow.grammar: Grammar: choose the natural article in “Ich gehe ___ Arzt.”
diagnosticFlow.readingText: The appointment notice says: “Sprechstunde am Dienstag um 10 Uhr.”
diagnosticFlow.completedBody: Saved in History. Your learning level is unchanged.
diagnosticFlow.limitedEvidence: Three local choices are insufficient to estimate a CEFR level.
diagnosticFlow.writingNotAssessed: Writing is not assessed here. Use Writing for feedback on an actual text.
diagnosticFlow.voiceUnavailable: Listening and speaking are not assessed here. Start a separate prepared activity in Codex Voice.
diagnosticFlow.sampleUncertainty: One local sample cannot establish proficiency.
diagnosticFlow.grammarEvidence: A short article-selection sample was completed.
diagnosticFlow.vocabularyEvidence: An everyday-word meaning sample was completed.
diagnosticFlow.readingTopic: Finding a time in a notice

practice.voiceContentNotice: When changing the scenario, also adapt the goals, questions, script and answer guidance. These contents are saved as entered.

voiceHandoff.openRequested: Opening requested. Send the prepared message in Codex, then start Voice in that task.
voiceHandoff.setupRequired: Open Settings / Account in Open Deutsch to install or refresh the Open Deutsch plugin and check Codex setup. Then try again.
voiceHandoff.failed: Codex could not be opened. Check that the ChatGPT desktop app is installed, then try Open in Codex again.
voiceHandoff.availability: Voice in existing tasks depends on your app, account and workspace. If Start voice chat is unavailable, update Codex or continue by text.
voiceHandoff.resume: To resume a conversation, return to its task in Codex. This button prepares a new chat.

modelControl.title: AI model
modelControl.reasoningHint: Lower effort is faster. Higher effort takes more time for deeper reasoning.

exercises.startFailed: Practice could not be started. No answer was saved.

direction.production: Produce the German word or phrase.

exercises.answerRequired: Enter a valid answer before submitting.
exercises.completionFailed: The answers could not be saved. They remain visible so you can retry.
exercises.abandonFailed: The set could not be abandoned. Your current answer remains visible.
exercises.abandonedBody: Completed answers were not added to History. You can start this generated set again later.

delete.title: Delete this quiz?
delete.body: This permanently removes the quiz and its unconfirmed vocabulary candidates. Confirmed vocabulary blocks deletion.
delete.cascadeBody: This permanently removes the quiz, its attempts, answers, feedback, related History entries, and unconfirmed vocabulary candidates.

aiFeedback.failed: Your answer was saved, but feedback is unavailable. Submit again to retry without losing your response.

custom.title: Create a quiz
custom.body: Ask for a topic, everyday scenario, grammar focus, vocabulary theme, or question format. The quiz is untimed and includes optional hints.
custom.request: What would you like to practise?
custom.failed: The quiz could not be created. Your request remains available to retry.

results.almost-correct: Almost correct — check the small differences
results.requires-ai: AI feedback is required for this open response

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.body: Confirm only the words you want to review. Open Deutsch keeps scheduling deterministic and explainable.
vocabulary.createBody: Group existing candidate words into a set. Add candidates through a writing correction first.
vocabulary.request: What should this set help with?
vocabulary.deleteConfirm: Delete this vocabulary card and its review history?

library.selectPage: Select all words on this page
library.noMatches: No words match this search and filter.
library.noSuggestions: Suggested words are needed to create a lesson set.

review.title: Vocabulary review
review.noneDue: No words are due right now.
review.failed: The result could not be confirmed. Skip this word or return to the library to refresh.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Continue with a focused activity or review what you learned recently.
dashboard.helperBody: Open explanations only when you need them. Your main task stays in focus.
dashboard.quickPracticeBody: Choose a focused local activity without waiting for AI.

helper.selectText: Select text in Writing to ask about it.
helper.sendHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

writing.title: Write in German
writing.intro: Keep the situation and your own text together. Nothing is sent until you explicitly start an AI action.
writing.promptBody: Generate a task for your level and interests, or write freely.
writing.contextPlaceholder: For example: ask a Hausverwaltung about a repair appointment
writing.contextHint: Optional context for this piece of writing. Keep it relevant and concise.
writing.changeSelectionHelp: Select a marked change to read its explanation.

correctionStages.queued: Correction queued. Your text is preserved.

correctionOutcomes.cancelled: Correction cancelled. Your text is still here.
correctionOutcomes.rate-limited: Codex is temporarily rate-limited. Your text is still here.

writing.localDraftNotice: Unsaved draft · Correct now saves the review.
writing.unsavedBody: Your unsaved prompt and German text will be discarded if you leave this workspace.

history.title: History
history.intro: Review saved attempts and feedback, then choose what to practise again.
history.empty: No saved activity matches these filters.
history.listeningNoAudio: Only explicit structured results are stored; Open Deutsch stores no audio or full transcript.
history.modelNotReported: The runtime did not report model and effort details.

voiceSummary.practiceCreated: Targeted practice is ready in your prepared activities.
voiceSummary.noAudio: Only this structured summary is stored; Open Deutsch does not store audio or a full transcript.

history.deleteBody: This permanently removes the saved attempt, answer, correction, and feedback. This action cannot be undone.
history.referenceOnly: This entry keeps a portable reference; its detailed reader belongs to a later activity workspace.

patterns.title: Mistake evidence
patterns.intro: Patterns are grouped by effective grammar or vocabulary category and date. Repetition is descriptive evidence, not a mastery score.
patterns.single: One observation only—not a recurring pattern or a mastery judgment.

source.mixed: This group includes inferred and learner-amended classifications.

practice.created: Targeted practice is ready in your prepared activities.
practice.cancelled: Targeted practice was cancelled. Your evidence was not changed.
practice.failed: Targeted practice could not be created. Your evidence was not changed.

pages.placeholder: This workspace is ready for the next implementation block.

startup.firstTitle: Choose where your learning records live
startup.firstBody: Choose where to keep your learning data.
startup.unavailableBody: Open Deutsch could not safely open the selected folder.
startup.schemaTitle: This learning folder needs a newer Open Deutsch
startup.schemaBody: Update the app or choose a compatible learning folder. The database will not be downgraded.
startup.lockedBody: Close another Open Deutsch window, then try again.
startup.staleBody: Reload or choose the folder again before continuing.
startup.missingBody: Reconnect the folder or choose another one.
startup.noBlank: The app remains available while recovery is in progress.

codex.missing: Codex is not installed. Local learning tools remain available.
codex.unsupported: This Codex version is unsupported. Upgrade Codex to use AI features.
codex.unavailable: Codex App Server is unavailable. Local learning tools remain available.
codex.signedOut: Connect your Codex account to use AI features.

folder.privacyBody: This folder contains readable local learning records. Open Deutsch restricts files it owns where supported, but does not encrypt the folder or replace operating-system disk encryption.
folder.cloudBody: Only text you select and minimized learning context are sent to OpenAI when you invoke an AI action. Codex and Voice follow your account data controls.
folder.confirmCheck: I understand where records are stored and when selected text is sent.
folder.cancelled: No folder was selected. Nothing was changed.
folder.warningGit: This folder is inside a Git worktree.
folder.warningBroad: Other local users may be able to read this folder.
folder.warningInstall: This folder is inside the application installation.
folder.warningRestart: Codex integrations must restart before using the new folder.

aiReminder.title: Before the first AI action
aiReminder.body: The selected text and only the context needed for this action will be sent to OpenAI through your installed Codex. Cancel to send nothing.

onboarding.title: Your learning preferences
onboarding.intro: Choose a few defaults now. You can change them later, and the app language remains a separate choice.
onboarding.accountConnected: Your managed Codex account is ready ({{plan}}).
onboarding.accountSignedOut: Codex is not connected. Local practice is available.
onboarding.accountExpired: Your Codex session needs to be connected again.
onboarding.accountUnsupported: This Codex authentication method is not supported by Open Deutsch.
onboarding.accountUnavailable: Codex status unavailable. You can continue locally.

login.opening-browser: Opening the secure Codex sign-in page…
login.failed: Account connection failed. Try again when you are ready.

onboarding.goalHint: For example: handle appointments and speak confidently with neighbours.
onboarding.skipPlacement: Skip the optional placement diagnostic for now

conversation-partner.title: Conversation partner
conversation-partner.body: German-first practice with selective corrections after you finish a thought.

strict-corrector.title: Strict corrector
strict-corrector.body: Precise, immediate correction of every meaningful error.

onboarding.localeIndependent: This does not change the Open Deutsch interface language.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Manage local learning defaults and the Codex capabilities reported by your installed runtime.
settings.dataSwitchConfirm: Switch to {{name}}? Your current data stays in its original folder.

account.expired: The Codex session needs to be connected again.
account.unsupported: The current authentication method is unsupported.

settings.codexUnavailable: Compatible Codex is unavailable; local settings remain usable.

plugin.refresh-required: Codex must refresh before the integration is available.

settings.notReported: Not reported by the current runtime.
settings.persistenceUnavailable: Settings cannot be edited in this app version.
settings.localeSeparate: Explanation language is independent of the interface language.
settings.savedModelFallback: This saved model or reasoning choice is unavailable. The effective choice shown above is used temporarily; your preference is preserved.
settings.diagnosticsPrivacy: This local health summary contains versions and counts only. It excludes learner text, model output, credentials, paths, and raw protocol data.

errors.boundaryTitle: This view could not be displayed
errors.boundaryBody: This view encountered an unexpected error. Try opening it again. Unsaved input may need to be entered again.
errors.validation: Some information is invalid or incomplete. Check the required fields and try again.
errors.notFound: This item is no longer available. Reopen the list and select another item.
errors.conflict: This item changed before the action finished. Reopen it to load the current version, then try again.
errors.staleDataRoot: The selected learning folder changed. Reopen this view before trying again.
errors.database: Open Deutsch could not read or save local learning data. Check that the selected folder is available and writable in Settings/Account, then retry.
errors.aiPolicy: Open Deutsch stopped this AI action because it encountered an operation outside the allowed learning workflow. Retry once. If it happens again, report the diagnostic reference.
errors.aiTimeout: Codex did not finish within the time limit. Try again with a shorter request or a smaller activity.
errors.modelUnavailable: The selected model or reasoning setting is unavailable. Choose Automatic or another available option in the model selector, then retry.
errors.appServer: The AI action could not finish. Retry once. If it fails again, check Codex in Settings/Account and report the diagnostic reference.
errors.authentication: Codex needs you to sign in. Open Settings/Account, connect your Codex account, then retry.
errors.unsupportedCodexVersion: Open Deutsch could not use this Codex installation. Check its status in Settings/Account and update or reinstall Codex if needed.
errors.rateLimit: Your Codex usage limit was reached. Check Settings/Account for the reset time and try again after it resets.
errors.modelOutput: Codex returned an incomplete or unusable result. Try again; if it keeps happening, try another model or report the diagnostic reference.
errors.mcp: The Codex integration could not complete this action. Check its status in Settings/Account and install or refresh the integration if needed.
errors.handoff: Open Deutsch could not open the related activity. Check the Codex integration in Settings/Account, then try again.
errors.unsupportedOperation: This action is unavailable in the current setup. Check Settings/Account for supported options.
errors.dataRootBusy: Finish or cancel the active AI operation before changing the data folder.

ui.actionFailed: Could not complete this action. Please try again.
ui.completeOptions: Complete the required activity options before saving.

suggestions.title: Practice next
suggestions.flexibleWeek: Choose what helps today. There is no schedule to catch up with.
suggestions.voiceGuidance: Adapt the conversation to the learner’s level. Give concise explanations and allow time to respond.
suggestions.voiceQuestion: What would you say in this situation?

personalData.title: Personal Data
personalData.intro: Understand what is saved, why it is needed, and what you can clear.
personalData.overviewHelp: A summary of your saved data. Counts show main records; related details and links are not counted twice.
personalData.supporting: The app also keeps links between records, your privacy acknowledgement, and small save/deletion records that prevent duplicates. These support the features above.
personalData.privacy: Your learning records are stored locally. When you use an AI action, selected text and learning context are sent through Codex. Codex manages its account and conversations separately; Open Deutsch does not store audio.
personalData.storageHelp: Your learning records share one local database. Larger files and research material have separate folders.

cleanup.intro: Clear a specific area or start again with an empty learning history. Every action asks for confirmation.
cleanup.caption: Selective cleanup
cleanup.permanent: This permanently deletes the listed records. There is no undo.
cleanup.retained: Cleanup keeps your account connection, privacy acknowledgement and duplicate/deletion markers. It does not delete attachments, research files, app configuration or diagnostic logs. Diagnostic controls remain in Settings/Account.

blocked.busy: An AI action is still running. Finish or cancel it before clearing data.
blocked.linked-vocabulary: Some vocabulary refers to this practice. Clear that vocabulary first, or choose “Clear all learning data”. No data was changed.
blocked.attachments: Saved attachment references prevent cleanup so that files are not left without their records. No data was changed.

practice.title: Exercises and practice
practice.removes: Removes all saved activities, lessons, exercises, attempts, answers, corrections, mistakes, learning insights, Voice summaries and their history.
practice.keeps: Keeps your profile details, preferences and vocabulary. Linked vocabulary must be cleared first.
practice.success: Practice, feedback and related history cleared.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary deck
vocabulary.removes: Removes suggested, active and paused words, vocabulary sets, review schedules and review history.
vocabulary.keeps: Keeps your profile, exercises and feedback. Words may still appear in saved exercise text.
vocabulary.success: Vocabulary deck, sets and review history cleared.

learning.title: Start fresh for testing
learning.removes: Removes all practice, lessons, answers, feedback, mistakes, learning insights, vocabulary, Voice summaries and learning history in this data folder.
learning.keeps: Keeps your profile details, preferences and selected data folder, so you can start practising again without onboarding.
learning.success: All learning records cleared. Your profile and preferences are ready for a fresh start.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.contains: Level, goals, interests and preferred topics.

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.contains: Teaching style, correction settings, language and model choices.
preferences.purpose: Remembers how you want to learn.

practice.title: Practice activities
practice.contains: Saved exercises, lesson content and prepared conversation scenarios.
practice.purpose: Lets you open and continue prepared practice.

attempts.title: Attempts and feedback
attempts.contains: Submitted answers, writing corrections and exercise results.
attempts.purpose: Shows your feedback and records what you practised.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
vocabulary.contains: Suggested and saved words, meanings, examples and review dates.
vocabulary.purpose: Builds your vocabulary deck and schedules reviews.

voice.title: Voice summaries
voice.contains: Saved summaries and feedback from listening and speaking practice. No audio.
voice.purpose: Brings the learning outcome back from Codex.

history.title: Learning history
history.contains: Activity dates, titles and saved results.
history.purpose: Lets you revisit past practice and see progress.

insights.title: Learning insights
insights.contains: Recurring mistakes, strengths, weaknesses and edited classifications.
insights.purpose: Helps identify useful topics to practise next.

files.title: Attachments
files.contains: References to local documents, images and imported texts.
files.purpose: Connects source material to learning activities.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Local attachment files; their references are stored in the database.

bootstrap.title: Selected-folder pointer
bootstrap.description: The path and generation used to reopen your selected data folder.

appConfig.title: Application configuration
appConfig.description: Electron configuration and browser runtime storage, outside the portable learner folder.

learningPath.title: Learning path
learningPath.intro: Learn German at your own pace. Follow the suggested order or choose any available unit.
learningPath.courseUnavailable: The A1.1 and A1.2 course is not available yet. You can continue in Practice.
learningPath.stageFinished: You’ve reached the end of this stage. Revisit skipped activities or choose another stage.
learningPath.progressMeaning: Completion shows participation, not a CEFR level. Skipped work is separate. Feedback describes only the activity that was assessed.
learningPath.challengeIntro: Check your German whenever you like. These untimed challenges are optional and never unlock or block lessons.
learningPath.challengeCoverage: Stage challenges sample different topics and all four skills. Unfinished sections remain unassessed. Repeat with new examples whenever you like.
learningPath.noEvidence: Not yet assessed. Completing lessons does not establish this skill.

messages.0: Longer requests can take a little time.
messages.1: The result will appear here when ready.
messages.2: You can wait or cancel this request.

developmentReset.body: Development update: Previous learning data was reset for the current data format. Your profile and settings were retained; files were not deleted.
